bills.summary: Would set tiered federal transparency and safety rules for frontier AI developers, scaled to company size, including model cards, risk-management frameworks, independent audits and incident reporting, as a uniform national standard; it sits with House Energy and Commerce.

bills.title: Data Center Water and Energy Transparency Act of 2026
bills.statusNote: Introduced Mar. 25, 2026; in committee.
bills.summary: Would require data centers to report energy and water use to their states (and planned facilities to estimate five years of use), with states sending aggregated data to EPA, DOE and USDA for regional reports and the agencies able to fine noncompliant operators.

source.title: GovInfo: S. 4213 (IS), Data Center Water and Energy Transparency Act of 2026
